name: brand-ai-readiness-audit
description: A 16-skill marketplace that audits any website for AI discoverability and on-site engagement issues across 6 GEO dimensions (crawlability, content extractability, entity clarity, schema integrity, off-page authority, technical foundation). Produces a structured JSON report with evidence-backed findings, prioritized suggested actions, and a per-engine GEO readiness score (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, Bing Copilot). Covers RC, CDN-WAF, CEA, EEAT, TSEO, OG, RSL, RC24-RC30 engagement, RC-TRUST, RC-NAV, GEO, CITE, and ORCH namespaces.
research_basis: Aggarwal et al., Princeton/ACM KDD 2024 — foundational GEO study (10,000 queries)
Onely 2026 — 5,000-site schema error study (78% error rate)
SE Ranking 2025 — review platform citation 3x lift
CXL 2026 — 55% of AI citations from first 30% of page
Backlinko/Semrush Jan 2026 — Reddit + LinkedIn top-2 cited domains

skills.description: Entrypoint: takes a URL, calls all 12 sub-skills in sequence, merges findings, scores GEO readiness by dimension and per-engine, and emits the final audit report.
Checks AI crawler access across 27 bots (3 tiers), llms.txt validity, sitemap freshness, feeds, and AI discovery endpoints. Covers RC2, RC4, RC7, RC14, RC17, RC19, RC23.
Checks JS-render gaps using Googlebot UA. 4-state page classification. Covers RC1, RC9, RC12, RC20.
Audits JSON-LD schema richness, missing types, freshness signals, paywall declarations, language gaps, and alt text. Covers RC3, RC10, RC11, RC13, RC15, RC16, RC18, RC21.
Checks Wikidata QID, sameAs links, entity collision risk, and name consistency. Covers RC5, RC6.
Checks CTA presence, above-fold value prop, paragraph scannability, response time, and dynamic state fallback. Covers RC8, RC16, RC22.
Tests LLM citation visibility via web_search. Checks brand awareness, product category ranking, and factual accuracy. Covers CITE-001 to 004.

Audits passage-level content structure for AI citation readiness. Answer-first structure, question-format headings, statistics with citations, paragraph lengths, FAQ quality. Based on Princeton KDD 2024 research. Covers CEA-001 to 008.
Checks E-E-A-T signals: author credentials, review platform profiles, Reddit presence, original research, LinkedIn company page. Covers EEAT-001 to 006.
Checks technical prerequisites for AI indexability: HTTPS, nosnippet/noindex, redirect chains, canonicals, heading hierarchy, hreflang, broken links. Covers TSEO-001 to 009.
Audits OpenGraph tags, Twitter Card, meta descriptions, og:image validity, and emerging Markdown alternate links. Covers OG-001 to 008.
Checks RSL 1.0 machine-readable licensing, llms-full.txt, AI FAQ/service/summary endpoints, IndexNow, and deep llms.txt spec validation. Covers RSL-001 to 005.

Audits the first-5-second landing experience for AI-referred visitors: H1 presence/conciseness, navigation item overload, above-fold CTA density, and AI-referrer handling signals. Covers RC24, RC25, RC28, RC30.

Audits content scannability and on-page trust signals: paragraph length, subheading density, on-site search, social proof, contact info, legal links, author bylines, breadcrumb navigation. Covers RC26, RC27, RC-TRUST, RC-NAV.
Tests URL integrity for AI-cited pages: catch-all homepage redirects, deep redirect chains, dead URLs in llms.txt/sitemap.xml, and absence of a dedicated AI-referrer landing page. Covers RC29, RC30.

Scoring layer: maps findings to 6 GEO dimensions, calculates per-engine scores (ChatGPT/Perplexity/Google AI Overviews/Gemini/Bing Copilot), produces overall GEO readiness % and prioritized action roadmap.
